content.name: Pooja Deshmukh
content.title: Store Manager
content.summary: Store manager with three years in organised retail in Pune, promoted from management trainee to running a home essentials store within two years. Leads a team of 11 and took monthly sales from ₹28 lakh to ₹36 lakh in the first year in charge.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Run a 4,500 sq ft home and kitchen store with a team of 11, responsible for sales, staffing, stock and store P&L.
Grew monthly sales from ₹28 lakh to ₹36 lakh by adding a wedding-gifting corner and weekend demos of kitchen appliances.
Brought stock loss down from 1.9% to 1.1% by introducing weekly cycle counts and a check at every inward delivery.

experience.title: Assistant Store Manager
bullets: Supported the store manager of a women's ethnic wear store and managed the floor on weekends and during festive sales.
Planned staff rosters for 14 team members during Diwali and wedding season, when footfall doubled.
Started a WhatsApp catalogue for regular customers that brought in ₹4 lakh of orders a month.

experience.title: Retail Management Trainee
bullets: Rotated through billing, visual merchandising, inventory and customer service in two stores.
Reorganised the back room by size and style, cutting the time to find items for customers by half.
Prepared daily sales and footfall reports in Excel for the area manager.

education.details: CGPA 7.9/10. Summer internship in a Pune supermarket chain's store operations team.

achievements.title: Fast promotion
achievements.detail: Promoted from trainee to store manager in two years.

achievements.title: Best festive store
achievements.detail: Store ranked first in the Pune cluster for Diwali 2024 sales growth.
